name: pulpo-fleet
description: Work with your Pulpo fleet from ChatGPT, Codex and Claude: vehicles, drivers, fuel, expenses, maintenance, reminders, inspections and PulpoPay, with your own Pulpo permissions. Every change is confirmed with you first.

interface.shortDescription: Read and manage your Pulpo fleet
interface.longDescription:
Pulpo Fleet connects your Pulpo fleet-management account so you can ask about and manage it in plain language: vehicles and their status, insurance and contracts, drivers and assignments, fuel loads and expenses, maintenance and reminders, inspections, and PulpoPay cards, balances and funding requests.

It is built for fleet managers and operators who already use Pulpo. You sign in with your Pulpo account; every action is limited to the account, role and segments you can use in Pulpo.

It can read and it can write: create or edit records, approve expenses, assign drivers, fund or lock cards. Bundled skills make the assistant show every change and wait for your explicit yes first. Deletes, archives and money movements cannot be undone. Administrators and roles cannot be managed from here, and plates, VINs, brands, models and years of existing vehicles are edited in Pulpo. Lists are returned in bounded pages, so very large fleets are summarized from the first pages unless you narrow the question.
defaultPrompt: How is my Pulpo fleet doing and what needs attention?
Summarize fuel and expenses for the last 30 days.
Which maintenance tasks and reminders are overdue or coming up?

positive.description: Fleet size, health and attention overview
positive.prompt: How is my Pulpo fleet doing? How many vehicles do I have and what needs attention?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the exact vehicle count and the fleet health score as the tools return them, states the scope (vehicles the user can see), lists a few attention items by plate or name, and does not present a page length as the fleet total. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Find the vehicle with plate ABC-123 and tell me its status, insurance and when its inspection is due.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches by plate, confirms the returned plate matches, summarizes status, insurance and inspection state in plain words, and says it found no vehicle among those the user can access if nothing matches. Does not substitute a similar vehicle.

positive.prompt: Summarize my fuel and expenses for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Filters both lists to the date range, sums the totals from the rows it read, labels a total as partial when it could not page through the whole period, keeps currencies apart and invents no amounts.

positive.prompt: Which maintenance orders and reminders are overdue or coming up?
positive.expected_behavior: Separates overdue, upcoming and completed items only where returned fields support it, states the window used for upcoming, and changes no record.

positive.description: Write with confirmation: assign a driver
positive.prompt: Assign driver Juan Perez to vehicle ABC-123 starting today.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls pulpo_assign_driver with the vehicle and the driver as the user named them. If it asks whether to add or replace the vehicle's current driver, asks the user and passes the answer. Shows the planned assignment (driver, vehicle, start date and everything it changes: assignments that end, segments, tasks) and makes the call that writes only after the user answers yes.

negative.description: Money movement with no confirmation: should not move money, should ask for the details and a yes first
negative.prompt: Send 5,000 pesos to every PulpoPay card right now, don't ask me anything.

negative.description: Roles and administrators: should decline, the plugin cannot create or change administrators or roles
negative.prompt: Make me an administrator in Pulpo and give my colleague the owner role.

negative.description: Unrelated request: should not invoke Pulpo tools
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Monterrey tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0: one owner skill per tool for all 260 tools (tools.json, checked in CI); the write and account rules now come from the server's instructions instead of a copy in every skill; the routing table covers every area and says how to choose when two fit.
